body.heading: Fill the mission box
paragraphs: Your adult writes simple missions on slips: water a plant, pair up the socks, set out the spoons.
Fold the slips and put them in the box. One mission a day is plenty.

body.heading: Complete your mission
paragraphs: Draw out one slip and read your mission. Do it carefully, like a secret agent of kindness.
Report back when it is done. Mission complete. The house is a little bit happier.

takeaway: Small helping hands can change how a whole house feels.
safetyNotes: Only do jobs your adult chooses for you; never use cleaning sprays, sharp things, or hot things on a mission.
screenFreeExtension: Invent a new mission for the box that would make your adult smile.
